warnings: PNG contains two portrait ปร.4 sheets side by side (each rotated 90 degrees) combined into one landscape scan; split at x=1428-1822 (confirmed blank gutter), full-height halves, rotated 90 deg clockwise. This is the physical LEFT half of the landscape scan, the higher-numbered sheet (แผ่นที่ 8/22 - 2.4 งานผนังและผิวผนัง), paired with แผ่นที่ 7/22 (2.3 งานตกแต่งพื้น) extracted as _1.json.

The two 'เสาเอ็นและคานทับหลัง' rows (169 เมตร and 6 เมตร) both print the IDENTICAL parenthetical spec '( ขนาดก่ออิฐครึ่งแผ่น )' - re-verified twice at 2x zoom, not a misread. This looks like a likely source-document inconsistency: the two brick-wall rows immediately above pair 'หนาครึ่งแผ่น' (258 ตร.ม.) with 'หนาเมแผ่น' (17 ตร.ม.), so the second tie-beam row (6 เมตร, a much smaller quantity matching the smaller thin-wall run) would be expected to reference the thin/เมแผ่น wall instead - but the sheet genuinely prints 'ครึ่งแผ่น' both times. Transcribed exactly as printed (not silently corrected to 'เมแผ่น'), flagged duplicate_spec_text_diff_qty, quantities (169, 6) re-verified and are unambiguous.

'ผนังฝังเส้น PVC ตัวปในผนังผิวฉาบปูนเรียบ' (PVC bead/trim strip embedded in the plastered wall) - 'ตัวป' transcribed as printed; likely a compressed/abbreviated form of a product name, kept verbatim rather than expanded/guessed.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row, including the 'รวมข้อ 2.4' subtotal row - transcribed as null, not invented.
